macros.slot_empty: This slot is empty. Create a macro to edit its steps.
macros.mode_help_repeat: Plays the given number of times per key press.
macros.mode_help_toggle: Press to start repeating, press again to stop.
macros.mode_help_while_held: Repeats while the key is held down.
macros.record_help: Record keys typed on the keyboard: the real gaps become the delays.
macros.recording: Recording: %1 events. Type the keys now, then stop.
macros.dropped: The macro is full: %1 recorded events were dropped
macros.full: A macro holds at most %1 steps
macros.delete_confirm: Delete macro M%1? Its steps are lost when you apply.
macros.delete_bound: Delete this macro? Keys bound to it (%1) get their default function back.
macros.default_delay_help: Delay in ms for added steps, the last recorded step and "Set all delays".
macros.no_steps: No steps yet: add keys or record them.
macros.bind_help: Click a key to make it play macro M%1; click it again to give it its default function back.
